from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class RegionMonthlyRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single data point for housing starts extracted from a single report."""
    report_date: str = Field(description="The date the report was released (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    data_month: str = Field(description="The month the data corresponds to (YYYY-MM)")
    region: Literal["Northeast", "Midwest", "South", "West"] = Field(description="The US Census region")
    value: float = Field(description="Seasonally adjusted total housing starts (annual rate)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Top-level aggregation of all extracted housing start records from the document collection."""
    records: list[RegionMonthlyRecord]
